summary: Veraxa Biotech AG, a Zurich-based foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under VRXA, filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release dated October 13, 2026. The release announces presentation of first in vivo proof-of-concept data plus additional in vitro data for its BiTAC-ADC technology platform at the 17th World ADC Congress in San Diego. No securities transaction, corporate action, or special situation occurred; the filing is a routine operational/clinical disclosure furnished under Rule 13a-16, with no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle.
